description: P53 (plan M11 §2.4, §2.5, decision 7): the two build sliders, each from -1 to 1 (0: the giant as built). The skin's and the garments' vertex shader pushes the surface along its normal by the body's build weights (COLOR.g brawn, COLOR.b girth) times the index's build_max_m; no joint moves. low and high name the slider's two ends.
